name: Ingenia Therapeutics Inc.
summary: Ingenia Therapeutics Inc. operates as a clinical-stage antibody biopharmaceutical company that discovers and develops biopharmaceutical candidates based on microvascular protection and recovery technology in the United States and South Korea. The company engages in the discovery and development of advanced therapeutics for patients afflicted by inflamed and leaky blood vessels. Its products for the treatment of ophthalmic diseases include IGT-427 for retinal diseases and IGT-302 for Glaucoma; and its systemic products include IGT-303 for CKD; IGT-532 for cancer; and other multiple candidates.
